interpretation: Author-claimed results are research intake only. Source pin, schema validation and a scope comparison do not validate a proof, assign novelty, or change the Solved ledger.

transfers.title: Local smoothing; Kakeya and interior Fourier restriction
transfers.scope_boundary: Claimed all-dimensional local smoothing implies Kakeya dimension and strict-interior restriction estimates. Endpoint cases and general restriction formulations are not automatically settled; M055 and M056 differ.
transfers.transfer_hypothesis: Audit the wave estimate to Kakeya and restriction implication chains with exact n,p,q and endpoint conventions.
transfers.falsifier: A missing dimensional hypothesis, unjustified endpoint passage, or unsupported maximal estimate breaks the purported implication.
transfers.next_action: Independently check the paper's local-smoothing-to-Kakeya/restriction reductions against the M055/M056 scope ledger; request specialists.

transfers.title: Matrix multiplication exponent at most 9/4
transfers.scope_boundary: A claimed omega <= 9/4 over C does not resolve the omega = 2 conjecture; characteristic and rectangular regimes require separate hypotheses.
transfers.transfer_hypothesis: Extract one finite tensor identity or restriction lemma and build an independent exact symbolic checker.
transfers.falsifier: The symbolic identity fails in an admissible small instance or the asymptotic extraction uses a missing hypothesis.
transfers.next_action: Record the exact field and tensor construction, derive checkable low-rank instances, compare with established preprint bounds.

transfers.title: Identity testing for noncommutative formulas
transfers.scope_boundary: Division-free noncommutative formulas and matrix evaluations are not arbitrary commutative arithmetic circuits; do not imply unrestricted deterministic polynomial identity testing.
transfers.transfer_hypothesis: Isolate a constructive hitting-point lemma for an explicitly named restricted formula class and field.
transfers.falsifier: Find a nonzero admissible formula that vanishes on the asserted hitting set or exceeds the claimed resource bound.
transfers.next_action: Write statement with formula-size, field-characteristic, matrix-dimension and bit-complexity parameters; test against exact symbolic expansion.

transfers.title: Claimed counterexamples to Hadwiger
transfers.scope_boundary: Arbitrarily-large existential construction is not a published explicit finite adjacency list. A Lean comparator checks encoded propositions, not the correctness of the full proof.
transfers.transfer_hypothesis: Reconstruct a finite graph witness or independently audit every step of the existential family construction.
transfers.falsifier: A proposed finite instance fails the chromatic/minor inequality or the construction's quantified hypotheses.
transfers.next_action: Extract exact finite adjacency data where feasible, check clique minor and chromatic lower bound independently, secure specialist assessment.

transfers.title: Claimed Sidorenko and forcing counterexamples
transfers.scope_boundary: The 35-vertex, 66-edge pattern is locally reconstructed; the host graph/graphon violating the homomorphism-density inequality is not yet independently replayed.
transfers.transfer_hypothesis: Find or reconstruct the host and exact rational density inequality in two separate checkers.
transfers.falsifier: The host does not satisfy the strict density inequality when exact homomorphism counts are recomputed.
transfers.next_action: Extract an explicit host with exact arithmetic, independently enumerate the homomorphisms, audit source hypotheses.

transfers.title: Claimed exclusion of nontrivial circulant Hadamard matrices
transfers.scope_boundary: The circulant subclass is not all real Hadamard matrices of orders 4n; excluding circulants beyond 4 does not disprove the general existence conjecture.
transfers.transfer_hypothesis: Extract the proposed circulant obstruction and compare with known Sylvester/Paley constructions as separate classes.
transfers.falsifier: A valid circulant Hadamard matrix of an excluded order, or an unsupported reduction from circulant to general matrices.
transfers.next_action: Formalize the exact circulant condition and test small orders in a second independent encoding; audit the claimed general argument.

transfers.title: Claimed counterexamples to Auslander–Reiten
transfers.scope_boundary: A finite-dimensional characteristic-two rational-function-field algebra is claimed, but the registered formulation over Artin algebras requires an exact ring-category and Ext-quantifier comparison.
transfers.transfer_hypothesis: Reconstruct the algebra and a finite presentation, then independently check the relevant Ext-vanishing and nonprojectivity.
transfers.falsifier: The example fails an Ext condition, becomes projective, or lies outside the registered algebra class.
transfers.next_action: Open a dedicated M046 claim-review entry with statement quantifiers, original construction, exact field, and independent algebra verification.
